scenarios.title: Election and replication
scenarios.blurb: Three nodes start together. The shortest timer wins a pre-vote, then a real election, appends a no-op, and replicates two puts.

scenarios.title: Partition and re-election
scenarios.blurb: The leader is cut off alone. It cannot commit. The remaining four nodes elect a new leader, commit, and the old leader catches up after the partition heals.

scenarios.title: Leader crash and restart
scenarios.blurb: A committed write survives the leader's crash. A new leader is elected from the surviving majority, and the restarted node rebuilds from its durable log.

scenarios.title: Snapshot catch-up
scenarios.blurb: A follower is down while the leader compacts its log. When the follower restarts, the leader installs a snapshot instead of replaying every entry.
